description: For a given congressional committee, returns which members have stock trades in CTA's records for the last N days, their trade counts, and the percentage of the committee with at least one recorded trade.

committee_name.description: Committee name or partial match, e.g. "Armed Services", "Finance"

days.description: Look-back window in days, measured on trade date (default 90). Disclosures can arrive up to 45 days after the trade (later if filed late), so the newest part of any window is incomplete.

name: get_committee_trading
title: Committee Trading Activity
